title: DOW-UAP-D084, US Army-Flying-Saucer-Study_1949
doc_notes: This document is an evaluation study prepared by the U.S. Army Plans & Operations Division in 1949 to determine if flying saucer reports were of foreign origin, concluding they were not, and includes routing slips and a radio digest containing a controversial claim by Walter Winchell regarding Soviet guided missiles.

incidents.summary: Evaluation of UAP phenomenon reports from June 1945 to 1949, noting that 20% of 210 incidents were explained as weather balloons, research equipment, meteors, or Venus.
